text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey's summer training camp is 
about to begin at last.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whether we can make a massive leap 
forward this summer will determine the 
future of our 'journey,' but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—And so, our family has made arrangements 
to support Journey-san during the training 
camp as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I am deeply humbled 
that you would go to such great lengths 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pay it no mind. 'If you're going to do 
something, do it thoroughly.'

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list: Once again, thank you so much from me too.

Once again, thank you so very much from me 
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I hear you have also been studying with 
great diligence, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If we can make this a fruitful summer for 
both of you, nothing would please me more.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Taking full advantage of your generosity, 
I intend to train you thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like crossing a scorching desert— the time 
of trial begins...!
